author: Zintenka
body:
On Avicus, I've noticed that a lot of maps have their coords written like this:

0, 0, 0

But occasionally I'd see this:

0,0,0

Which one is correct or are both acceptable?

Aight! This is good, now I definitely know that the XML that I've been working on for 2 days isn't completely broken!

I'd have a crash if it did, and I'd rage, I'd flip a table, I'd use one of my friends as a barbell and I'd fuckin' ERRRRGH KILL A CAT!

Jkjk, I'd probably just... slump down and close my eyes, this XML is really complicated and tedious. So many coords and checks...
